drivers.label: Fit / Size Uncertainty
drivers.description: User is unsure about sizing, fit, or body-type compatibility. Signals include mentioning being between sizes, requesting size charts, or expressing fear of wrong fit.

drivers.label: Price / Deal-Timing Uncertainty
drivers.description: User is waiting for a price drop, sale event, or better deal before purchasing. Signals include mentioning sales, discounts, price comparisons, or waiting for offers.

drivers.label: Styling / Occasion Uncertainty
drivers.description: User is unsure how to style the item or what occasion it suits. Signals include asking about outfit pairings, occasion appropriateness, or color matching.

drivers.label: Trust / Review Credibility Doubt
drivers.description: User doubts the authenticity of reviews, product quality claims, or brand trustworthiness. Signals include questioning fake reviews, product-photo mismatches, or brand reliability.

drivers.label: Comparison Paralysis
drivers.description: User has saved multiple similar items and cannot decide between them. Signals include mentioning too many options, indecision, or requests for comparison help.

drivers.label: Wishlist-as-Bookmark Behavior
drivers.description: User treats the wishlist as a browsing tool rather than a purchase intent list. Signals include saving items casually, window shopping behavior, or explicitly stating no purchase intent.

drivers.label: Return / Exchange Friction Fear
drivers.description: User is deterred by the perceived hassle of returns or exchanges. Signals include mentioning return policies, past bad return experiences, or fear of being stuck with a wrong item.

drivers.label: Social Validation Seeking
drivers.description: User wants external opinions before purchasing. Signals include asking friends, posting on social media for feedback, or seeking community approval.

drivers.label: Wishlist Abandonment / Forgetting
drivers.description: User forgets about wishlisted items or loses interest over time. Signals include mentioning forgotten items, expired interest, or items sitting in wishlist for too long.

drivers.label: External Research Before Purchase
drivers.description: User leaves the app to research the product elsewhere. Signals include googling brand reviews, checking YouTube for product demos, or comparing prices on other platforms.
